component: MIME forward separator I/O result handling

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: After opening the appended body stream, the original patch writes MSG_LINEBREAK without checking the returned status or separatorBytes. A focused repair would need to define failure/short-write handling before continuing with the body. This finding is limited to the original separator call; accepted later code uses separate pieces, and no I/O failure, truncation or current error-handling guarantee was executed.
title: The original MIME append separator ignores the write status and byte count
